title: Five Places to Go in D.C.’s North Shaw Area
abstract: Once a 15-acre swath of gritty streets, parking lots and vacant buildings, North Shaw is the latest residential, retail and creative hub in the district.

title: Five Places to Go in Prague
abstract: Prague’s Vrsovice district has become something of a cultural melting pot with a breezy bohemian vibe, attracting an international crowd.
